items.title: Trump apoia proibição da exportação de diesel conforme preços dos combustíveis atingem níveis recordes
items.author: Gram Slattery, Ryan Patrick Jones, Timothy Gardner
items.creator: Gram Slattery, Ryan Patrick Jones, Timothy Gardner
items.summary: O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, afirmou nesta terça-feira que apoiava a proibição das exportações de diesel, enquanto candidatos republicanos em algumas das disputas eleitorais mais acirradas de novembro defendiam a medida como forma de conter os preços recordes dos combustíveis.
items.body:
O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, afirmou nesta terça-feira que apoiava a proibição das exportações de diesel, enquanto candidatos republicanos em algumas das disputas eleitorais mais acirradas de novembro defendiam a medida como forma de conter os preços recordes dos combustíveis.
Os preços do diesel atingiram níveis recordes nos EUA e na Europa, à medida que as guerras no Irã e na Ucrânia reduziram drasticamente as exportações de alguns dos maiores produtores, como Rússia, Arábia Saudita e Emirados Árabes Unidos.
“Eu disse: ‘Não vamos exportar o diesel. Produzimos muito diesel... Eu pedi isso. Eu pedi isso à minha equipe’”, disse Trump a repórteres antes de uma reunião com o presidente ucraniano, Volodymyr Zelenskiy.
Os altos preços dos combustíveis são um ponto fraco para Trump nas eleições de 3 de novembro, nas quais os republicanos tentam manter a maioria nas duas Casas do Congresso.
O secretário do Tesouro dos EUA, Scott Bessent, falando na mesma reunião, disse que o governo estava analisando se tal proibição seria viável e se uma proibição total ou parcial funcionaria.
Vários candidatos republicanos nas disputas eleitorais mais acirradas para o Congresso em todo o país, como o senador Dan Sullivan, do Alasca, a deputada federal Ashley Hinson, de Iowa, e Mike Rogers, de Michigan, pediram que o governo Trump implementasse a proibição.
“O combustível americano deve ficar aqui com os americanos”, disse Sullivan em comunicado nesta terça-feira. “O custo do diesel está simplesmente alto demais. Estou pedindo uma suspensão temporária das exportações de diesel americano para que possamos reconstruir nossas reservas antes do inverno e colocar as famílias americanas e do Alasca em primeiro lugar.”
A acessibilidade dos alimentos e de outros bens está no topo das preocupações dos eleitores antes das eleições de meio de mandato.
Hinson e Rogers também pediram, na segunda-feira, o fim imediato da guerra no Irã, distanciando-se de Trump.
O Departamento de Agricultura dos EUA instou, na semana passada, a Casa Branca a tomar medidas em relação aos preços do diesel, segundo duas fontes a par do assunto. A secretária de Agricultura, Brooke Rollins, disse na segunda-feira que havia conversado com Trump sobre o assunto, classificando os preços altos como “uma preocupação real”, segundo o Politico.
AUTORIDADES DO SETOR DE ENERGIA ALERTAM PARA OS RISCOS O apoio de Trump à proibição da exportação de diesel o coloca em desacordo com suas próprias autoridades do setor de energia, que alertam que isso poderia elevar os preços dos combustíveis nas regiões costeiras e reduzir o abastecimento para os aliados europeus.
O secretário de Energia, Chris Wright, disse em um evento do Daily Caller na semana passada que uma proibição levaria a um excesso de diesel na Costa do Golfo dos EUA e levaria as refinarias norte-americanas a reduzir as taxas de produção, o que diminuiria rapidamente a produção de gasolina. “Se você começar a impor barreiras aos fluxos, rapidamente reduzirá a produção e terá menos oferta. Precisamos de mais oferta, não de menos”, disse Wright.
Doug Burgum, secretário do Interior dos EUA, disse que é improvável que uma proibição reduza os preços do petróleo e que isso poderia levar a medidas retaliatórias por parte dos países exportadores de energia, dos quais Estados como a Califórnia dependem para parte de seu abastecimento energético.
O setor petrolífero também se opôs à proibição. Todd Staples, presidente da TXOGA, uma associação comercial de petróleo e gás natural do Texas, disse que isso “prejudicaria os empregos no mercado interno, levaria à escassez de combustível no país e colocaria o poder nas mãos da China e da Rússia, forçando nossos aliados a recorrer a esses países para suprir suas necessidades”.
Embora uma proibição à exportação de diesel pudesse, em teoria, reduzir temporariamente os preços na Costa do Golfo dos EUA, ela restringiria ainda mais a oferta na Europa, que sofre com uma escassez estrutural de diesel e depende fortemente das exportações dos EUA.
“Isso pareceria bastante prejudicial para alguns aliados-chave dos EUA”, disse Jim Mitchell, diretor de análises de comercialização de petróleo da consultoria Wood Mackenzie.
Trump disse que ele e Zelenskiy discutiriam os ataques ucranianos a refinarias de petróleo na Rússia.
“É um golpe sério para os russos. É também um golpe sério para o preço do diesel”, disse Trump, que também informou aos repórteres que os dois líderes discutiriam uma solução para pôr fim à guerra da Rússia na Ucrânia.
“Acho que isso vai acontecer”, disse Trump.

items.title: US Treasury secretary could take on AI czar role, source says
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent could become President Donald Trump’s new AI czar, a source familiar with the discussions said on Tuesday, as fears grow among lawmakers in Washington about the risks posed by AI technology.
items.body:
Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent could become President Donald Trump’s new AI czar, a source familiar with the discussions said on Tuesday, as fears grow among lawmakers in Washington about the risks posed by AI technology.
Trump has repeatedly downplayed concerns about AI and argued that additional regulation is unnecessary.
Treasury had no immediate comment on Bessent's possible new role, which was first reported by Semafor.
Trump on Saturday said that he plans to appoint a new artificial intelligence adviser, [USN:FWN45B02T TEXT:"known as an "AI czar,""] and create an "AI force," though he did not provide details about either initiative or how they would be implemented.
Bessent led talks on Sunday with Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng in New York ahead of this week's summit between Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping in Washington. The talks focused heavily on AI.
Bessent told reporters after the talks that Washington had proposed a [USN:L1N45B04Y TEXT:"new AI safety notification mechanism"] and a new US-China AI dialogue, with a particular emphasis on national security concerns.
Trump previously tapped Bessent, a former hedge fund manager, to play a lead role in a major revamp of US trade policy, negotiate with Ukraine about critical minerals and temporarily head the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau.
He also serves as acting commissioner of the Internal Revenue Service, and his Treasury is leading a push to isolate Iran economically through sanctions and other measures.

items.title: Así fue el diálogo entre Trump y el vicepresidente de Colombia en la Cumbre del Escudo de las Américas
items.author: Daniel Guerrero
items.summary: José Manuel Restrepo explicó a Donald Trump por qué Abelardo De la Espriella no asistió al encuentro y destacó la iniciativa regional como un mecanismo para fortalecer la seguridad y proteger las demo ...
items.body: Bogotá — El vicepresidente de Colombia, José Manuel Restrepo, sostuvo este martes un breve intercambio con el presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, durante el encuentro del Escudo de las Américas realizado en Nueva York, en el marco de la Asamblea General de Naciones Unidas. La conversación comenzó con una referencia a la ausencia del presidente colombiano Abelardo De la Espriella. Restrepo explicó a Trump que el mandatario no pudo asistir porque debía atender asuntos internos en Colombia. “Él no pudo venir porque está atendiendo asuntos internos hoy en día en Colombia”, dijo Restrepo al presidente estadounidense. Trump respondió haciendo referencia a la decisión de De la Espriella de permanecer en Colombia durante su mandato. “Él hizo una promesa de no salir del país y yo le dije: honra tu promesa”, afirmó Trump durante el encuentro. Después de la intervención de Trump, Restrepo llevó la conversación hacia la situación política colombiana y el propósito que, según planteó, tiene la alianza regional. “Durante las últimas elecciones casi perdimos la democracia de Colombia”, aseguró el vicepresidente. Restrepo vinculó esa situación con la necesidad de fortalecer mecanismos de cooperación entre los países del continente. En ese contexto, destacó el papel que puede tener el Escudo de las Américas. “Creo que este tipo de iniciativas como el Escudo de las Américas es una forma de preservar nuestras democracias en la región”, afirmó. El vicepresidente explicó que esa protección, según su planteamiento, pasa por trabajar simultáneamente en distintos frentes. “Al trabajar en la seguridad económica, al trabajar en la seguridad, la seguridad física, podemos preservar las democracias en nuestra región”, agregó Restrepo. Trump respondió al planteamiento del vicepresidente destacando el alcance que, a su juicio, está adquiriendo la iniciativa en el hemisferio. “Tenemos un impulso en este momento de la humanidad en esta región del mundo para trabajar juntos para preservar las democracias y crecer más. Así que muchas gracias”, dijo Restrepo durante el encuentro. A continuación, Trump agradeció las palabras del vicepresidente y señaló que el proceso que se desarrolla en la región está siendo observado internacionalmente. “Gracias, señor, y sabe que se está hablando de esta parte del mundo en todas las demás partes del mundo”, respondió el presidente estadounidense. Trump añadió una valoración sobre el proceso y ofreció respaldo a los países participantes: “Lo que están haciendo es increíble. Creo que pasará a la historia. Así que, si podemos ayudarte, háganoslo saber. Muchas gracias a todos”. El encuentro se produjo en el marco de la iniciativa impulsada por Trump para coordinar a países del hemisferio en materia de seguridad y lucha contra organizaciones criminales transnacionales. El Escudo de las Américas fue presentado oficialmente en marzo y contempla cooperación entre los países participantes frente al crimen organizado y los carteles del narcotráfico. Colombia se incorporó formalmente a la iniciativa durante el actual Gobierno. En los primeros contactos entre Bogotá y Washington, la agenda también ha incluido seguridad regional, lucha contra el crimen transnacional, migración, inversión y crecimiento económico. El encuentro de este martes reunió a Trump con varios mandatarios y representantes de países de la región. Entre ellos estuvieron los presidentes de Argentina, Chile, Ecuador, Guyana, Honduras, Paraguay, Perú y República Dominicana, además de Restrepo como representante de Colombia. La participación del vicepresidente colombiano se da mientras encabeza la delegación del país ante la Asamblea General de la ONU. Restrepo fue designado por De la Espriella para representar a Colombia en Nueva York, en línea con la decisión del mandatario de no salir del país durante su periodo presidencial.

items.body:
Un video que muestra a manifestantes lanzando objetos contra policías después de que un hombre británico matara a tres niñas en 2024 se comparte erróneamente en línea como si mostrara disturbios por el apuñalamiento de una niña por parte de un solicitante de asilo.
Un ejemplo que difundió el video en Facebook el 30 de agosto dice: “La turba en el Reino Unido después de que otra niña pequeña fuera apuñalada por un solicitante de asilo”.
Sin embargo, el video se publicó en línea el 30 de julio de 2024 y muestra protestas violentas en Southport, en el noroeste de Inglaterra, después de que un hombre nacido en Reino Unido matara a tres niñas en un evento temático de Taylor Swift en la localidad.
Un portavoz de la Policía de Merseyside dijo que las imágenes fueron grabadas durante los disturbios de esa fecha.
Una comparación del clip con imágenes en Google Maps de la calle St Luke's en Southport, que la policía de Merseyside dijo fue escenario de disturbios ese día, muestra los mismos inmuebles y vegetación.
Axel Rudakubana, de 18 años y nacido en Gales, [USN:S8N3HP021 TEXT:"admitió"] posteriormente haber matado a las niñas y apuñalado a otras 10 personas. Fue [USN:L5N3OJ0TU TEXT:"condenado"] a al menos 52 años de prisión.
La violencia estalló en Reino Unido ese año tras [USN:L6N3JM0G0 TEXT:"falsas acusaciones"] difundidas en línea de que el sospechoso era un solicitante de asilo que llegó en barco antes de que se diera a conocer la identidad de Rudakubana.
Reuters no encontró informes creíbles sobre un solicitante de asilo que hubiera apuñalado a una chica al momento de la publicación difundida en redes sociales. Un portavoz de la policía de Merseyside por su parte dijo que no ha atendido ningún caso reciente que pudiera describirse como “un solicitante de asilo apuñalando a una chica”.
VEREDICTO Erróneamente etiquetado. El vídeo muestra disturbios en Southport en 2024 después de que un hombre nacido en Reino Unido matara a tres niñas en un evento temático de Taylor Swift, y no se trata de una protesta reciente por un solicitante de asilo que haya apuñalado a una chica.
Reuters Fact Check ofrece información confiable mediante su canal de WhatsApp para México . Envíenos un mensaje con el contenido en español que desea que verifiquemos.
Este artículo fue realizado por el equipo de Reuters Fact Check. Lea más sobre nuestro trabajo de verificación de afirmaciones en las redes sociales.

items.title: 'Looksmaxxing' influencer Clavicular charged with rape in Massachusetts
items.author: Nate Raymond
items.creator: Nate Raymond
items.summary: The social media "looksmaxxing" influencer known as Clavicular has been charged with raping a 17-year-old girl who told police she became intoxicated at his family's home on Massachusetts' Cape Cod after he invited her to join him on live stream videos.
items.body:
The social media "looksmaxxing" influencer known as Clavicular has been charged with raping a 17-year-old girl who told police she became intoxicated at his family's home on Massachusetts' Cape Cod after he invited her to join him on live stream videos.
Braden Peters, 20, was charged with rape, drugging a person for sexual intercourse, and procuring alcohol for someone under 21, according to a criminal complaint issued on September 8. He is slated to be arraigned in a state court in Orleans, Massachusetts on October 14.
His spokesperson Mitchell Jackson said the accuser had previously filed a lawsuit against Peters. He said the accuser and her attorney went to the police after Peters moved to dismiss the case and "refused to pay money."
"Looksmaxxing" is an online subculture focused on maximizing people's physical attractiveness. Peters has become a face of the trend, garnering a large following on social media platforms like TikTok and becoming known for endorsing a practice of breaking facial bones with a hammer to have them grow back stronger, which medical experts advise against.
According to court documents, Peters' accuser went to the police in Chatham to report him on June 4.
She told police the two had initially messaged each other on Instagram and he later paid her to be in “looksmaxxing” videos he produced.
The accuser, whose name was redacted from the charging documents, said that after about a week of talking, Peters ordered her an Uber to his family's residence in Chatham on May 23, 2025.
According to the police report, the accuser said Peters was aware she was 17 but told her to lie on a live stream he was recording on the platform Twitch and say she was 18 and that vodka he gave her was water.
The girl told police she became increasingly intoxicated. In a clip from Peters’ livestream that police reviewed, the girl at one point said, "wait I’m so drunk" before the two kissed, according to the police report.
She said she later fell asleep in Peters' bed and the next morning woke up to him "having sex with me" without consent.

items.title: Trump apoya una prohibición a la exportación de diésel mientras los precios alcanzan récords
items.author: Gram Slattery, Ryan Patrick Jones, Timothy Gardner
items.creator: Gram Slattery, Ryan Patrick Jones, Timothy Gardner
items.summary: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, dijo el martes que apoyaba una prohibición a las exportaciones de diésel, algo que candidatos republicanos para las elecciones legislativas de noviembre reclaman para frenar el alza de los precios del combustible.
items.body:
El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, dijo el martes que apoyaba una prohibición a las exportaciones de diésel, algo que candidatos republicanos para las elecciones legislativas de noviembre reclaman para frenar el alza de los precios del combustible.
Los precios del gasóleo se han disparado a máximos históricos en Estados Unidos y Europa, ya que los conflictos en Irán y Ucrania han reducido drásticamente las exportaciones de algunos de los mayores productores, como Rusia, Arabia Saudita y los Emiratos Árabes Unidos.
"He dicho que no enviemos el diésel. Producimos mucho diésel (...) Lo he pedido. Se lo he pedido a mi equipo", dijo Trump a periodistas antes de una reunión con el presidente ucraniano, Volodímir Zelenski.
Los altos precios del combustible suponen un punto débil para Trump antes de las elecciones del 3 de noviembre, en las que los republicanos intentan mantener la mayoría en ambas cámaras del Congreso.
El secretario del Tesoro de Estados Unidos, Scott Bessent, en su intervención en la misma reunión, dijo que el Gobierno estaba estudiando si la prohibición era viable y si funcionaría una total o parcial.
Varios candidatos republicanos en las contiendas al Congreso más reñidas de todo el país, como el senador Dan Sullivan en Alaska, la diputada Ashley Hinson en Iowa y Mike Rogers en Míchigan, han pedido a la Administración Trump que aplique la prohibición.
"El combustible estadounidense debe quedarse en casa, con los estadounidenses", dijo Sullivan en un comunicado el martes.
"El precio del gasóleo es sencillamente demasiado alto. Pido una suspensión temporal de las exportaciones de gasóleo estadounidense para que podamos reponer nuestras reservas antes del invierno y dar prioridad a las familias estadounidenses y de Alaska", añadió.
La asequibilidad de los alimentos y otros productos es otra de las principales preocupaciones de los votantes.
Hinson y Rogers también pidieron el lunes un rápido fin a la guerra en Irán, distanciándose así de Trump.
El Departamento de Agricultura de Estados Unidos instó la semana pasada a la Casa Blanca a tomar medidas respecto de los precios del gasóleo, según dos fuentes familiarizadas con el asunto.
La secretaria de Agricultura, Brooke Rollins, dijo el lunes que había hablado con Trump sobre el asunto y calificó los altos precios de "una verdadera preocupación", según Politico.
ADVIERTEN DE RIESGOS El respaldo de Trump a la prohibición de exportar gasóleo lo enfrenta a sus propios responsables de energía, quienes advierten de que podría elevar los precios del combustible en las costas y reducir el suministro a los aliados europeos.
El secretario de Energía, Chris Wright, dijo la semana pasada en un acto organizado por The Daily Caller que una prohibición provocaría un exceso de oferta de gasóleo en la costa del golfo de México de Estados Unidos y llevaría a las refinerías estadounidenses a recortar sus tasas de producción, lo que reduciría rápidamente la producción de gasolina.
"Si empiezas a poner barreras a los flujos, muy pronto reducirás la producción y tendrás menos suministro. Necesitamos más suministro, no menos", dijo Wright.
Doug Burgum, secretario del Interior de Estados Unidos, señaló que es poco probable que una prohibición reduzca los precios del petróleo y que podría dar lugar a medidas de represalia por parte de los países exportadores de energía, de los que dependen estados como California para parte de su suministro energético.
Aunque una prohibición de la exportación de diésel podría, en teoría, reducir temporalmente los precios en la costa del Golfo de Estados Unidos, restringiría aún más el suministro en Europa, que sufre una escasez estructural de gasóleo y depende en gran medida de las exportaciones estadounidenses.

items.title: Bloomberg Businessweek Daily: Trump Addresses UN (Podcast)
items.summary: President Trump said US officials had a “very good” meeting with Iranian representatives, a rare direct encounter that offers a fresh opportunity to restart talks to end the nearly seven-month war. Trump didn’t provide details on who participated in the meeting, but referred to his special envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, who sat alongside the president. The US administration has signaled a renewed effort to end the war in the Middle East, with Trump claiming the conflict will end just after the November US midterm elections, if not before. Earlier on Tuesday in his UN address, Trump threatened to “annihilate” Iran if its officials don’t strike a deal. Meantime, President Trump dismissed calls for an international agreement to put guardrails around the development of artificial intelligence, brushing off concerns about the dangers of frontier models going rogue. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Ottawa opens up 15% Trans Mountain equity stake to Indigenous groups on pipeline path
items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: The Canadian government is offering Indigenous groups a collective 15 per cent ownership stake in the Trans Mountain pipeline through a low-cost loan.
items.body: OTTAWA — The Canadian government has offered Indigenous groups a collective 15 per cent ownership stake in the Trans Mountain pipeline, advancing a long-promised plan to give First Nations equity in the federally owned infrastructure connecting Alberta crude to a Vancouver-area export terminal.  In a letter to a First Nation along the pipeline’s path seen by The Canadian Press on Tuesday, a Department of Finance official said the equity investment would be equally distributed among participating groups “through a low-cost government-provided loan.” The Trans Mountain equity offer follows consultations and discussions with 129 First Nations, said John Fragos, spokesperson for Finance Minister François-Philippe Champagne. Ottawa is now gauging interest among the Indigenous nations before determining the finer details, including the size of individual stakes and the terms for buying in, he said. “The government’s position on economic reconciliation is long-standing and clear: Indigenous communities must be able to participate in and directly benefit from the projects shaping Canada,” Fragos said in a statement. He added that each Indigenous nation that invests in Trans Mountain is set to receive $2.5 million, intended to compensate for revenue they might have earned had Indigenous ownership been put in place years earlier. “We’re making up for lost time,” he said in a followup call.  Meanwhile, the letter said Ottawa will provide eligible groups with up to $100,000 for participation costs, while separately covering independent advisers to assist with due diligence. Details of the offer will be shared during a series of in-person meetings in Vancouver, Victoria, Kamloops and Edmonton planned for late October, the letter added.  Ottawa bought the existing Trans Mountain pipeline, its expansion project and related assets for $4.5 billion in 2018 after Kinder Morgan investors raised concerns that regulatory uncertainty made the investment too risky. It later committed to exploring Indigenous economic participation in the expansion with the 129 Indigenous communities potentially affected by the project. The expansion began operations in 2024 and increased the Trans Mountain system’s capacity to about 890,000 barrels per day from roughly 300,000 barrels per day.  Finance documents released that year said Ottawa planned to provide Indigenous groups with access to capital to acquire a stake in Trans Mountain. The documents said the Indigenous stake could be held collectively through a special-purpose vehicle, giving participating groups governance rights and a share of cash generated by the pipeline. Until now, however, the government had not publicly specified the size of the ownership stake it was prepared to make available. --- Brett Bundale, The Canadian Press This report by The Canadian Press was first published Sept. 22, 2026.

items.title: Anthropic, OpenEvidence partner to bring medical AI worldwide
items.author: Nancy Lapid
items.creator: Nancy Lapid
items.summary: Artificial intelligence startup Anthropic and medical knowledge platform OpenEvidence are collaborating to bring AI-powered clinical decision support to physicians in regions without access to the technology, the companies said on Tuesday.
items.body:
Artificial intelligence startup Anthropic and medical knowledge platform OpenEvidence are collaborating to bring AI-powered clinical decision support to physicians in regions without access to the technology, the companies said on Tuesday.
OpenEvidence answers doctors' questions by drawing on peer-reviewed medical research and treatment guidelines. The platform is free to clinicians in the United States and Europe.
The new initiative is a specialized version available to healthcare providers for free in dozens of low- and middle-income countries where limited access to medical literature, specialist expertise and continuing medical education can impair patient care.
Healthcare systems worldwide are exploring whether generative AI can help address shortages of physicians and specialists. Supporters argue that AI tools can help clinicians quickly navigate vast amounts of medical information, while critics caution that systems trained primarily on data from high-income countries may not reflect local practice conditions.
The initiative is being rolled out in about 100 countries, including Uganda, Angola, Sudan, Haiti, and Mongolia, according to a list provided by OpenEvidence.
"Access to medical knowledge shouldn't depend on geography," OpenEvidence founder Daniel Nadler said.
[USN:L6N45814Q TEXT:"Reuters reported"] last week that Anthropic had built a lab to do physical biology work as it pushes its artificial intelligence ambitions into drug science and as fears of AI's reach grip the public, with some executives and lawmakers calling for a slowdown in development.
Anthropic and OpenEvidence did not disclose financial terms of the collaboration.
REGIONAL DIFFERENCES In August alone, US clinicians consulted OpenEvidence 42 million times, according to Nadler. In 2026, several hundred million Americans will have been treated by a doctor who used OpenEvidence to help guide care, he said.
Anthropic's technology will provide back-end support, while OpenEvidence will tailor the system to different regions, taking healthcare infrastructure into account, the companies said.
“The technology itself has advanced so dramatically that the sort of structure needed for (bringing OpenEvidence to low-resource regions) is there, but the market incentives alone would not let it happen without this type of entrepreneurial, philanthropically minded work,” Anthropic president Daniela Amodei said.
Earlier this year, OpenEvidence said it was working with health organizations in Rwanda and Botswana to adapt its tools for settings where disease patterns, diagnostic resources and available treatments differ markedly from those in wealthier countries.
“One hundred percent of what we are building for these places is context adaptive,” Nadler said.
Even where medical facilities don’t have around-the-clock electricity, most physicians do have smartphones, he said, which means access to quality medical information that a decade ago would only be available at leading institutions like the Mayo Clinic.
Dr. Ahmed Bendary, a cardiologist at Benha University in Egypt, said expanding this access outside the United States and Europe "would be a tremendous leap forward, particularly in regions where institutional subscriptions to major medical journals are limited, making evidence-based, point-of-care tools even more vital."

President Trump said US officials had a “very good” meeting with Iranian representatives, a rare direct encounter that offers a fresh opportunity to restart talks to end the nearly seven-month war. Trump didn’t provide details on who participated in the meeting, but referred to his special envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, who sat alongside the president. We get reaction from Bloomberg's Tyler Kendall & Nick Wadhams. Meantime, the shipping insurance industry has found itself at the forefront of the ongoing conflict. Axis CEO Vince Tizzio joins to discuss. Plus - Peloton CEO Peter Stern joins the show as the fitness powerhouse rolls out a new lineup of treadmills. All on the latest episode of "Bloomberg Businessweek Daily."
(Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Report: Raptors sign Kawhi Leonard to $115M extension
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: All-Star forward Kawhi Leonard has agreed to a two-year, $115 million contract extension with the Toronto Raptors, plus a player option for the 2028-29 season, ESPN reported on Tuesday.
items.body:
All-Star forward Kawhi Leonard has agreed to a two-year, $115 million contract extension with the Toronto Raptors, plus a player option for the 2028-29 season, ESPN reported on Tuesday.
The report, citing Leonard's agent Harrison Gaines of Slash Sports, said Leonard has three years and $165 million on his deal with the Raptors, who re-obtained the player on Sept. 14 in a long-delayed trade from the Los Angeles Clippers.
Leonard agreed to take $11 million less than his maximum contract extension amount as well as waive a $7.5 million trade kicker to come back to Toronto.
The trade, initially agreed to on June 30, was officially signed off on by both teams after months of delay amid the NBA's investigation into Los Angeles allegedly giving Leonard impermissible benefits.
In return for sending Leonard to Toronto, where in his lone season the Raptors won the 2019 NBA championship, the Clippers received forward Brandon Ingram, guard Gradey Dick, two unprotected first-round picks, one first-round pick swap and two second-round picks.
Those acquired picks will help to replace the five first-round picks the league stripped from the Clippers for the $28 million "no-show job" the Clippers arranged for Leonard through one of their partners, Aspiration, in order to circumvent the salary cap. The NBA found the Clippers also made arrangements to pay Leonard through team partners Boingo Wireless, Daktronics and Lockton Insurance.
Clippers owner Steve Ballmer announced Sept. 13 that he would accept the NBA's punishment, which included a one-year suspension and a $30 million fine along with the forfeited draft picks.
Leonard, 35, averaged 25.1 points, 6.4 rebounds, 4.1 assists and 1.7 steals per game over 331 games (329 starts) across the past six seasons for the Clippers. He averaged a career-high 27.9 points in 65 regular-season games last season.
The seven-time All-NBA player and two-time NBA Defensive Player of the Year was with the Raptors for just one very eventful season, where he anchored the first NBA title in franchise history before signing as a free agent with Los Angeles that offseason.
Leonard has averaged 20.7 points, 6.4 rebounds, 3.1 assists and 1.7 steals over 798 games (769 starts) across 14 seasons with the San Antonio Spurs (2011-18), Raptors (2018-19) and Clippers (2019-26).
He was voted the NBA Finals MVP in leading the Spurs (2014) and Raptors to titles.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Belgium, Rwanda resume diplomatic relations after DRC conflict dispute
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Belgium and Rwanda have resumed diplomatic relations 18 months after breaking ties due to a dispute over the conflict in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo.
items.body:
Belgium and Rwanda have resumed diplomatic relations 18 months after breaking ties due to a dispute over the conflict in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo.
Belgian Foreign Minister Maxime Prevot and Rwanda's foreign ministry both posted the news on X alongside photos of Prevot and his Rwandan counterpart Olivier Nduhungirehe in New York, where the United Nations General Assembly is taking place.
The two countries expelled each other's diplomats in March 2025 as relations deteriorated over the conflict in Rwanda's neighbour.
The AFC/M23 rebels control large parts of North and South Kivu provinces following their early 2025 advance, during which they captured Goma and Bukavu, eastern Congo's two largest cities. The UN and Western governments say the group is backed by Rwanda, which Kigali denies.
Rwanda says it is defending itself against the threat from a Hutu militia, which it says is fighting with the Congolese military. Both DR Congo and Rwanda are former Belgian colonies.
In a joint statement on Tuesday, Belgium and Rwanda said the two foreign ministers held a series of meetings and informal contacts over recent months, addressing a number of differences and misunderstandings "in a constructive spirit".
They also thanked Qatar for facilitating a first meeting in June 2025 and said they planned to reopen their respective embassies soon.
Prevot wrote on X that this was an important step "in a world marked by growing tensions".
"Restoring diplomatic relations between states does not mean abandoning our position, but having structured channels for dialogue, and I will continue to defend the territorial integrity and sovereignty of the DRC," he said.

items.title: Smaller packs, more protein: AB InBev to adapt drinks to shifting tastes
items.author: Emma Rumney
items.creator: Emma Rumney
items.summary: Anheuser-Busch InBev will sell smaller pack sizes, beers with added protein or electrolytes and push further into drinks beyond beer, executives said on Tuesday, as the top brewer looks to grow amid shifting drinking habits, strained incomes and a trend towards health and wellness.
items.body:
Anheuser-Busch InBev (ABI.BR) will sell smaller pack sizes, beers with added protein or electrolytes and push further into drinks beyond beer, executives said on Tuesday, as the top brewer looks to grow amid shifting drinking habits, strained incomes and a trend towards health and wellness.
The world's largest brewer by market value will look to drive higher beer consumption and grow revenue from non-beer products like canned cocktails and energy drinks, executives told investors at a capital markets event.
Brewers including AB InBev, which makes labels like Corona and Stella Artois, have been battling to grow beer volumes and revive weak demand in some large markets like the United States as some consumers cut back, prompted by pressure on their wallets or changing tastes.
AB InBev Chief Marketing Officer Marcel Marcondes said one aim was to grow consumption among infrequent beer drinkers, with budget-conscious consumers in this category presenting the most significant opportunity.
"Data is showing us huge opportunities to make beer more affordable, especially in developing markets," he said, adding AB InBev will address this by increasing both smaller pack sizes and larger ones offering higher quantities for less.
Increasing non-alcoholic beer consumption during casual meals presented another major opportunity, he said, adding AB InBev would drive that via zero-alcohol beers with different flavours, low calories and even protein or electrolytes. The company has launched a version of its Spaten beer with added protein in Brazil.
In the US especially, AB InBev has also been pushing into categories other than beer, including with top-selling canned cocktail label Cutwater and some energy drinks. Executives said it would expand further in these areas, with energy drinks alone potentially adding $25 billion to AB InBev's addressable market.
"In this space, we are the challengers, which gives us huge headroom for growth," CEO Michel Doukeris said.

items.title: Trump promete “poderio militar sem igual” contra cartéis de drogas
items.author: Simon Lewis
items.creator: Simon Lewis
items.summary: O presidente norte-americano, Donald Trump, prometeu nesta terça-feira reafirmar o domínio dos EUA no Hemisfério Ocidental e utilizar “poderio militar sem igual” contra as ameaças na região, ao reunir aliados em torno de uma campanha cada vez mais ampla contra os cartéis de drogas.
items.body:
O presidente norte-americano, Donald Trump, prometeu nesta terça-feira reafirmar o domínio dos EUA no Hemisfério Ocidental e utilizar “poderio militar sem igual” contra as ameaças na região, ao reunir aliados em torno de uma campanha cada vez mais ampla contra os cartéis de drogas.
Ao se dirigir aos líderes mundiais na Assembleia Geral da ONU, Trump classificou os cartéis de drogas como “o Isis (Estado Islâmico) do Hemisfério Ocidental” e pediu uma resposta mais firme ao crime transnacional.
Mais tarde, na sede da ONU, Trump se reuniu com líderes e ministros das Relações Exteriores de 14 países da América Latina e do Caribe que aderiram ao “Escudo das Américas”, uma coalizão anticartéis lançada por seu governo. Ele pediu ao grupo que se unisse aos EUA para designar 24 grupos narcotraficantes como ameaças à estabilidade e impor sanções contra eles.
Os países emitiram posteriormente uma declaração comprometendo-se a tomar medidas no sentido dessas sanções conjuntas.
A operação dos EUA que capturou o líder venezuelano Nicolás Maduro e um acordo petrolífero subsequente com o governo interino ressaltaram a disposição dos EUA de agir na região, disse Trump aos líderes mundiais na Assembleia Geral.
“Nossas ações na Venezuela são prova de que os Estados Unidos não permitirão mais que ameaças à América ganhem espaço em qualquer lugar do Hemisfério Ocidental e, se necessário, usaremos nosso poderio militar sem igual para garantir os interesses nacionais vitais dos Estados Unidos”, afirmou.
A Estratégia de Segurança Nacional de Trump, divulgada no final do ano passado, traçou planos para uma versão renovada da Doutrina Monroe — a política do século 19 que afirma a primazia dos EUA em todas as Américas e que os críticos há muito associam a décadas de intervenção norte-americana. O próprio Trump passou a chamá-la de “Doutrina Donroe”, um trocadilho com seu próprio nome, depois que a expressão ganhou popularidade na mídia conservadora.
Trump também falou, muitas vezes em termos vagos, em retomar o Canal do Panamá e anexar a Groenlândia e o Canadá. Nesta terça-feira, ele assinou um acordo sobre a Groenlândia que não chega a atender à sua exigência de que a ilha se torne território dos EUA para conter a crescente presença da Rússia e da China no Ártico.
Ainda assim, o foco de Trump no Hemisfério Ocidental tem suscitado preocupações quanto a um projeto neocolonial.
O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, em seu discurso na ONU nesta manhã, reagiu com indignação a essa abordagem, alertando os países da América Latina e do Caribe sobre “novas tentações hegemônicas”. “O Brasil não é quintal de ninguém”, afirmou Lula.
ESCUDO DAS AMÉRICAS O encontro do grupo Escudo das Américas foi a mais recente iniciativa dos EUA para mobilizar as nações latino-americanas em torno de uma abordagem mais agressiva, que incluiu ataques militares dos EUA a embarcações de contrabando de drogas desde o outono passado e maior cooperação com os países latino-americanos.
Trump lançou o grupo em março, reunindo mais de uma dúzia de líderes regionais na Flórida.
A coalizão inclui governos estreitamente alinhados com Trump, entre eles países como Argentina, Equador e El Salvador, cujos líderes Trump elogiou ou apoiou como candidatos. Colômbia e Peru aderiram depois que presidentes alinhados a Trump assumiram o poder nos últimos meses.
Brasil e México estão entre os países que não aderiram.
Desde que voltou ao poder no início do ano passado, Trump designou os cartéis de drogas como organizações terroristas estrangeiras e lançou dezenas de ataques mortais contra embarcações no Caribe e no Pacífico Oriental que, segundo autoridades norte-americanas, transportam narcóticos com destino aos EUA. Grupos de direitos humanos afirmaram que os ataques, que mataram mais de 220 pessoas, equivalem a execuções extrajudiciais.
“Durante décadas, outros governos permitiram que grande parte desta região fosse dominada por gangues cruéis e cartéis de drogas sanguinários, desestabilizada pela migração descontrolada e infiltrada por adversários estrangeiros hostis – adversários estrangeiros doentios e dementes –, mas isso acabou”, disse Trump à ONU, acrescentando que estava “reafirmando o poder americano" para tornar a região mais segura ao eliminar os cartéis.
“Assim como o Isis, eles devem ser mortos, exilados ou detidos como combatentes inimigos, sem possibilidade de libertação”, disse Trump, “e é isso que estamos fazendo”.
Trump também destacou a campanha de pressão de seu governo contra a Cuba comunista, acusou seus líderes de fomentar grupos de esquerda “subversivos e radicais” nos Estados Unidos e disse que o secretário de Estado Marco Rubio estava “em negociações avançadas com Cuba”.
Os cartéis de drogas que controlam territórios no México, vizinho dos EUA, eram “inaceitáveis”, disse ele, insistindo que o governo daquele país “precisa recuperar o controle de seu solo das mãos dos inimigos da humanidade”.

items.title: 米追加利上げ観測、企業の物価期待抑制が鍵に＝リッチモンド連銀総裁
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Howard Schneider

[ボルチモア　２２日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Howard Schneider

[ボルチモア　２２日　ロイター] - 米リッチモンド地区連銀のバーキン総裁は２２日、米国の経済状況は「堅調さを増している」との認識を示した。個人消費が継続しているほか、人工知能（ＡＩ）投資ブーム以外でも力強さが見られるため、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）はインフレに焦点を当て続けていると述べた。

バーキン氏は、アナリストの業界団体であるＣＦＡ協会のボルティモア支部で行う講演原稿で「インフレのリスクは最大雇用のリスクを上回っている。それが先週の会合で利上げを実施した理由だ」と説明。２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）の利上げは、インフレ率をＦＲＢの目標である２％に戻すのに「役立つ」と述べた。 

その上で「追加利上げが必要になるか、また何回必要になるかについては今後見極めていく」と語った。

バーキン氏の発言は、インフレに対する懸念を広げてきた他のＦＲＢ当局者らの見解に続くものだ。当局者らは、インフレが単にエネルギーや関税措置など、自然に解消されると予想される供給問題だけでなく、経済における強い需要によってますます押し上げられていると感じている。 

また、企業が来年度予算や価格戦略を検討する際には、来年のインフレ見通しが重要な判断材料になると指摘。ＦＲＢによる利上げや追加利上げ観測が企業のインフレ期待を抑制し、物価上昇圧力を和らげる可能性があるとの見方を示した。

経済についても「過熱を主張するつもりはまだないが、経済は堅調さを増しており、弱まってはいない」と指摘。不確実性の時代を経て、企業や機関は投資・支出の判断をためらわなくなっているとの見方を示した。多くの企業は依然として価格決定力を持っていると感じているとも述べた。

総裁は、こうした「一時的な」ショックでさえ「短期間の単発的な出来事にとどまらず」、当初想定されていたよりも根強い物価上昇圧力を生み出していると指摘。

「中東紛争や関税措置の影響を特に強く受けているごく一部の品目が原因で高インフレが起きていると考えたくなる」が、個人消費支出（ＰＣＥ）物価指数の多くの項目は年率３％を超えるペースで上昇していると述べた。

その上で「データセンター以外の分野でも勢いを感じている。防衛部門は活況を呈しており、製造業の関係者からはより楽観的な声が聞かれるようになってきた。銀行関係者からは、新規案件のパイプラインが堅調だと聞いている」と述べた。

労働市場については、「過熱しておらず、特に逼迫しているわけでもない」と指摘。消費者のバランスシートが過度に膨らんでいる証拠はあまり見られず、雇用市場が健全である限り消費者は支出を続けるとの認識を示した。

さらに足元の生産性向上については、その大部分がＡＩを反映しているとは考えていないと述べた。現在の局面については、１９９０年代の景気サイクル半ばの調整に似たものになると考えたいと語った。

金融環境については、ＦＲＢが細心の注意を払っているとしつつ、市場金利がインフレ抑制に必要な水準にとどまると想定することはできないと指摘。「きょうのイールドカーブが、あすのイールドカーブと同じになると当てにすることはできない」と述べた。

バーキン氏は今年の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で投票権を持たない。

さらに足元の生産性向上については、その大部分がＡＩを反映しているとは考えていないと述べた。現在の局面については、１９９０年代の景気サイクル半ばの調整に似たものになると考えたいと語った。

金融環境については、ＦＲＢが細心の注意を払っているとしつつ、市場金利がインフレ抑制に必要な水準にとどまると想定することはできないと指摘。「きょうのイールドカーブが、あすのイールドカーブと同じになると当てにすることはできない」と述べた。

バーキン氏は今年の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で投票権を持たない。

items.title: Peso mexicano retrocede antes de decisión Banxico, bolsa extiende ganancias
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El peso mexicano se debilitó el martes por la cautela previa a la decisión del Banco de México esta semana, en una sesión marcada por comentarios de funcionarios de la Reserva Federal que apuntaron a persistentes preocupaciones sobre la inflación en Estados Unidos.
items.body:
El peso mexicano se debilitó el martes por la cautela previa a la decisión del [USN:L6N45D0SW TEXT:"Banco de México"] esta semana, en una sesión marcada por comentarios de funcionarios de la [USN:L1N4580T6 TEXT:"Reserva Federal"] que apuntaron a persistentes preocupaciones sobre la inflación en Estados Unidos.
Se espera que el banco central mexicano mantenga sin cambios su tasa de referencia el jueves, en contraste con el incremento al costo de los créditos que anunció la Fed la semana pasada, al tiempo que ofreció señales de nuevos ajustes en los próximos meses.
* La moneda local cerró en 17.2720 unidades por dólar, con una depreciación de 0.32%, a medida que la [USN:L1N45E0UY TEXT:"divisa estadounidense"] subió en una volátil sesión, luego de haber alcanzado previamente un máximo de dos meses.
* Los [USN:L6N45E0ZR TEXT:"precios del petróleo"], a su vez, descendieron por menores preocupaciones sobre el suministro, después de que el presidente [USN:L1N45E0KU TEXT:"Donald Trump"] afirmó ante la Asamblea General de la ONU que un acuerdo de paz con Irán podría llegar tras las legislativas estadounidenses a principios de noviembre.
* [USN:L6N45E0V9 TEXT:"Tom Barkin"], presidente de la Fed de Richmond, dijo que la economía estadounidense podría estar consolidándose, por lo que la inflación sigue siendo un tema central, mientras que [USN:L6N45E0OC TEXT:"Susan Collins"], de la Fed de Boston, advirtió de mayores riesgos de que el indicador permanezca por encima de la meta del 2%.
* El mercado local estará pendiente del anuncio de Banxico esta semana. Las estimaciones apuntan a que la [USN:L6N45D0SW TEXT:"tasa clave"] se mantendría estable al menos hasta la segunda mitad de 2028, por lo que analistas han dicho que el foco estará puesto en las perspectivas que ofrezca sobre la [USN:L1N45B01H TEXT:"trayectoria de la inflación"].
* La bolsa mexicana subió por segunda jornada consecutiva, luego de haber tocado su nivel más bajo en lo que va del año. El índice S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) ascendió un 1.45%, a 64,456.59 puntos, siguiendo un sólido desempeño de [USN:L6N45E114 TEXT:"Wall Street"].
* Los títulos del grupo aeroportuario OMA (OMAB.MX) encabezaron las alzas, con un 3.99% más a 222.68 pesos. Les siguieron los papeles del minero Grupo México (GMEXICOB.MX) , que avanzaron un 3.65% a 222.27 pesos.
* En el mercado de deuda, los rendimientos primarios de los Certificados de la Tesorería (Cetes) registraron cambios mixtos en la subasta semanal de valores gubernamentales. La tasa del referencial Cete a 28 días fue colocada en un 6.15%, 10 puntos base por debajo de su remate previo.

items.title: Em discurso de despedida na ONU, Macron chama diplomacia de Trump para Gaza de "espetáculo" vergonhoso
items.author: John Irish
items.creator: John Irish
items.summary: O presidente da França, Emmanuel Macron, rejeitou nesta terça-feira as alegações do presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, de que garantiu a paz em Gaza, afirmando que nenhum corredor humanitário havia sido reaberto no enclave, apesar da paz proclamada.
items.body:
O presidente da França, Emmanuel Macron, rejeitou nesta terça-feira as alegações do presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, de que garantiu a paz em Gaza, afirmando que nenhum corredor humanitário havia sido reaberto no enclave, apesar da paz proclamada.
Em seu discurso final na Assembleia Geral das Nações Unidas antes de deixar o cargo no próximo ano, Macron disse que o mundo estava testemunhando um espetáculo que deveria envergonhar a todos, repreendendo a forma como Trump apresentou seu plano de paz para Gaza como um triunfo diplomático.
Ele discursou na Assembleia Geral das Nações Unidas poucas horas após Trump, da mesma tribuna, ter saudado seu plano de paz para Gaza como um triunfo diplomático.
“Há um ano, aqui mesmo neste salão, cerca de uma dúzia de países havia reconhecido a Palestina. Ouço o cinismo de algumas pessoas: ‘O reconhecimento é apenas um pedaço de papel, veja a realidade’”, disse Macron, batendo com o punho no pódio em seu último discurso na ONU antes de deixar o cargo, em maio próximo.
“Mas que credibilidade temos se continuarmos inativos diante da situação em Gaza? Alguns se gabam de uma suposta paz. Mas essa paz não reabriu o acesso humanitário nem por um único segundo. Vamos simplesmente ficar parados assistindo a esse espetáculo que deveria envergonhar a todos nós?”
A Casa Branca não respondeu imediatamente a um pedido de comentário.
“Há um ano, quando me dirigi aos grandes líderes neste salão, a guerra em Gaza ainda se desenrolava brutalmente”, disse Trump em seu discurso. “Algumas semanas depois, pusemos fim à guerra em Gaza, salvando milhares e milhares de vidas.”
Macron tem enfrentado críticas de alguns políticos e ativistas na França, acusando-o de ter feito pouco desde que reconheceu o Estado palestino, em setembro passado.
Apesar das críticas, Paris endureceu sua postura em relação à violência dos colonos contra os palestinos na Cisjordânia, impondo algumas sanções nacionais e iniciando um processo para proibir produtos provenientes dos assentamentos israelenses na Cisjordânia ocupada.
“Veja o que está acontecendo na Cisjordânia, onde todos os dias são cometidas violações. Em nome de quem? O Hamas nunca atuou na Cisjordânia”, disse Macron.
“O que está acontecendo lá é a construção, dia após dia, da impossibilidade de um projeto que deveria se basear no respeito ao direito legítimo do povo palestino de existir.”
As relações da França com Israel têm estado particularmente tensas ao longo do último ano. Macron afirmou que estão enganados os que acreditavam que violar a soberania de todos os vizinhos de Israel garantirá sua segurança.
“Eles estão enfraquecendo a segurança de Israel, tanto hoje quanto no futuro”, disse.
VIDA LONGA A sete meses da próxima eleição presidencial da França, Macron fez sua última aparição desde que subiu pela primeira vez à tribuna, em 2017.
Macron alertou para um “retorno à lei da selva” global, afirmando que os países enfrentam uma escolha entre um mundo governado pelo poder e pela coerção e uma “sociedade internacional civilizada”.
“Nosso dever, mais do que nunca, é estar ao lado das Nações Unidas. Não podemos aceitar a nova ordem de impunidade que alguns gostariam de construir”, disse ele.
Ele encerrou seu discurso com “Vida longa às Nações Unidas!”

items.title: ＮＹ市場サマリー（22日）ナスダック連日最高値、ドル続伸　利回り低下
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ＜為替＞　ドルが続伸して取引を終えた。原油価格の乱高下でインフレ見通しが不透明になる中、序盤に２カ月ぶりの高値を付けた後、不安定な値動きが続いた。    原油価格は序盤、２週間ぶりの安値まで下落していた。イランが、米国が軍事的圧力を緩和し、イランの港湾封鎖を解除すれば、７日以内にホルムズ海峡を再開できると述べたことや、イランと米国が紛争終結に向けた交渉再開の可能性を示唆したことが手掛かりとなった。    しかし、トランプ氏が国連総会での演説で、１１月の中間選挙後にイランとの合意に達すると考えていると述べたことで、原油とドルが上昇。序盤の楽観的なムードは後退した。    ＣＭＥのフェドウオッチによると、市場では米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）による１０月会合での利上げを巡って見方がほぼ二分しており、少なくとも２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）の利上げ確率は５５．４％と、前日の５７．６％から低下している。
items.body:
＜為替＞　ドルが続伸して取引を終えた。原油価格の乱高下でインフレ見通しが不透明になる中、序盤に２カ月ぶりの高値を付けた後、不安定な値動きが続いた。    原油価格は序盤、２週間ぶりの安値まで下落していた。イランが、米国が軍事的圧力を緩和し、イランの港湾封鎖を解除すれば、７日以内にホルムズ海峡を再開できると述べたことや、イランと米国が紛争終結に向けた交渉再開の可能性を示唆したことが手掛かりとなった。    しかし、トランプ氏が国連総会での演説で、１１月の中間選挙後にイランとの合意に達すると考えていると述べたことで、原油とドルが上昇。序盤の楽観的なムードは後退した。    ＣＭＥのフェドウオッチによると、市場では米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）による１０月会合での利上げを巡って見方がほぼ二分しており、少なくとも２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）の利上げ確率は５５．４％と、前日の５７．６％から低下している。    主要通貨に対するドル指数は０．１７％高の１００．５９。同指数は一時、７月３０日以来の高値となる０．２９％高の１００．７０を付けたものの、０．１１％下落する場面もあった。    ドルは対円では０．０３％高の１５７．４１円と、３営業日続伸となる勢い。日銀が１８日の金融政策決定会合で利上げを決定したにもかかわらず、円は圧力にさらされている。より慎重なペースを主張した政策委員２人の反対票について、市場は追加利上げの実施が難しくなる可能性を示唆していると受け止めている。    ユーロは０．１８％安の１．１４４１ドル。    英ポンドは０．２３％安の１．３３３２ドルと、２営業日続落の見通しとなった。過去７営業日で６回目の下落となる。 

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞　国債利回りが低下した。米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が追加利上げを実施するか見極めようとする動きが続く中、この日はインフレ懸念の緩和につながる原油価格の下落に反応し、１０年債や２年債などの利回りが低下した。

終盤の取引で１０年債利回りは２．２ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下の４．９４１％。先週は５．０４１％と、２００７年以来の高水準を付けていた。

トランプ米大統領はこの日に国連総会で行った一般討論演説で、１１月上旬の中間選挙後に米国がイランと合意に達するとの見方を表明。その後、記者団に対し、米政府当局者がこの日にイラン代表団と約３時間にわたり「極めて良好な」協議を行ったと明らかにした。

これに関連してイラン国営メディアは、イランのアラグチ外相がこの日にニューヨークで米国のウィットコフ和平交渉担当特使と会談し、戦略的要衝であるホルムズ海峡の通航再開に向けたイランの条件を米国に伝えたと報道。 米国時間の原油先物は下落し、北海ブレント先物は約１％安の１バレル＝９９．２５ドルで取引を終えた。

原油価格は対イラン軍事攻撃を受け急騰しており、インフレ加速と金利上昇に対する懸念が強まる要因になっていた。

米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は１５─１６日に開いた連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で、インフレ抑制を目的に２０２３年７月以来初めて利上げを決定。ＦＯＭＣに合わせて公表された金利・経済見通しでは、年内に少なくともあと１回の利上げが実施される可能性が示唆された。

ＣＭＥフェドウオッチによると、１０月２７─２８日の次回ＦＯＭＣで追加利上げが決定される確率は約５５％。

終盤の取引で、ＦＲＢの金融政策見通しに敏感な２年債利回りは２．５ｂｐ低下の４．７２８％。一時は４．７８７９％と、約２年ぶりの高水準を付けていた。

２年債と１０年債の利回り格差は２１．１ｂｐ。

３０年債利回りは１．５ｂｐ低下の５．２８１％。 

米金融・債券市場：[US/BJ]

＜株式＞　ナスダック総合が連日で終値での最高値を更新した。半導体大手マイクロン・テクノロジーや人工知能（ＡＩ）関連銘柄に買いが入り、ナスダック指数を押し上げた。また、原油価格が１バレル＝１００ドル近辺で推移する中、Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種８月１３日に付けた過去最高値に迫った。

マイクロンは５％高、サンディスクは約７％高となった。

メタ・プラットフォームズが投入したＡＩアシスタント「ミューズ」の成功が、このところＡＩ関連半導体株への買いを後押ししている。

一方、ミューズが小売業者やオンライン証券会社など消費者向け企業と競合するとの懸念から、消費者向けソフトウエア株などに売りが広がった。

配車アプリ大手ウーバー・テクノロジーズとリフトはともに１％超下落。チャールズ・シュワブは６．１％安、民泊仲介大手エアビーアンドビーは３％安となった

原油先物は下落。トランプ米大統領が２２日の国連総会一般討論演説で、イランとの戦闘終結に向けた合意に至らなければ同国を「壊滅させる」可能性があると警告したことが材料視された。

市場では、２４日に予定されている米中首脳会談に注目が集まっている。

Ｓ＆Ｐ主要１１セクターのうち６セクターが下落。ＪＰモルガン・チェースとウェルズ・ファーゴがともに３％超下落する中、金融は１．６８％安となった。通信サービスも０．８％下落した。

Ｓ＆Ｐ５００種指数では、値上がり銘柄数と値下がり銘柄数はほぼ拮抗した。

米取引所の合算出来高は１７９億株と、直近２０営業日の平均である１６３億株を上回った。 

米国株式市場：[.NJP]

＜金先物＞　米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の追加利上げ観測が意識され、金相場は下落。米東部時間午後１時４０分（日本時間２３日午前２時４０分）時点で、金現物は０．２％安の１オンス＝４３３６．２１ドル、米金先物の清算値は０．２％安の４３７６．４０ドルだった。トレーダーの間では１２月の利上げ確率が９０％と見込まれている。セントルイス連銀のムサレム総裁やシカゴ連銀のグールズビー総裁は、旺盛な需要とエネルギー価格上昇に起因するインフレを抑えるため、さらなる利上げの必要性を示唆した。金価格は１月に付けた過去最高値５５９４．８２ドルから２２％超下落している。高金利環境では金は利回りを生む資産に対して魅力が薄れるため、相場の重しとなっている。

ＮＹ貴金属：[GOL/XJ]

＜米原油先物＞　サウジアラビアが東西パイプラインを再稼働させ、原油供給が拡大したことに加え、ホルムズ海峡を通る船舶の動きが活発化したことを背景に下落した。

北海ブレント先物の１１月限清算値は１．０９ドル（１．０９％）安の１バレル＝９９．２５ドル。

米ＷＴＩ先物の１０月限は２２日に取引最終日を迎え、１．１９ドル（１．２４％）安の９４．９９ドルで取引を終えた。

両指標とも取引時間中に２ドル超下落する場面もあった。

サウジアラビアによる東西パイプラインの操業再開により、西部の紅海沿岸のヤンブー港からの輸出は２２日中に再開する可能性がある。

items.title: ＮＹ市場サマリー（22日）ナスダック連日最高値、ドル続伸　利回り低下
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ＜為替＞　ドルが続伸して取引を終えた。原油価格の乱高下でインフレ見通しが不透明になる中、序盤に２カ月ぶりの高値を付けた後...
items.body:
ＮＹ市場サマリー（22日）ナスダック連日最高値、ドル続伸　利回り低下
6:13 配信

＜為替＞　ドルが続伸して取引を終えた。原油価格の乱高下でインフレ見通しが不透明になる中、序盤に２カ月ぶりの高値を付けた後、不安定な値動きが続いた。    原油価格は序盤、２週間ぶりの安値まで下落していた。イランが、米国が軍事的圧力を緩和し、イランの港湾封鎖を解除すれば、７日以内にホルムズ海峡を再開できると述べたことや、イランと米国が紛争終結に向けた交渉再開の可能性を示唆したことが手掛かりとなった。    しかし、トランプ氏が国連総会での演説で、１１月の中間選挙後にイランとの合意に達すると考えていると述べたことで、原油とドルが上昇。序盤の楽観的なムードは後退した。    ＣＭＥのフェドウオッチによると、市場では米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）による１０月会合での利上げを巡って見方がほぼ二分しており、少なくとも２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）の利上げ確率は５５．４％と、前日の５７．６％から低下している。    主要通貨に対するドル指数は０．１７％高の１００．５９。同指数は一時、７月３０日以来の高値となる０．２９％高の１００．７０を付けたものの、０．１１％下落する場面もあった。    ドルは対円では０．０３％高の１５７．４１円と、３営業日続伸となる勢い。日銀が１８日の金融政策決定会合で利上げを決定したにもかかわらず、円は圧力にさらされている。より慎重なペースを主張した政策委員２人の反対票について、市場は追加利上げの実施が難しくなる可能性を示唆していると受け止めている。    ユーロは０．１８％安の１．１４４１ドル。    英ポンドは０．２３％安の１．３３３２ドルと、２営業日続落の見通しとなった。過去７営業日で６回目の下落となる。 

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞　国債利回りが低下した。米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が追加利上げを実施するか見極めようとする動きが続く中、この日はインフレ懸念の緩和につながる原油価格の下落に反応し、１０年債や２年債などの利回りが低下した。

終盤の取引で１０年債利回りは２．２ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下の４．９４１％。先週は５．０４１％と、２００７年以来の高水準を付けていた。

トランプ米大統領はこの日に国連総会で行った一般討論演説で、１１月上旬の中間選挙後に米国がイランと合意に達するとの見方を表明。その後、記者団に対し、米政府当局者がこの日にイラン代表団と約３時間にわたり「極めて良好な」協議を行ったと明らかにした。

これに関連してイラン国営メディアは、イランのアラグチ外相がこの日にニューヨークで米国のウィットコフ和平交渉担当特使と会談し、戦略的要衝であるホルムズ海峡の通航再開に向けたイランの条件を米国に伝えたと報道。 米国時間の原油先物は下落し、北海ブレント先物は約１％安の１バレル＝９９．２５ドルで取引を終えた。

原油価格は対イラン軍事攻撃を受け急騰しており、インフレ加速と金利上昇に対する懸念が強まる要因になっていた。

米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は１５─１６日に開いた連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で、インフレ抑制を目的に２０２３年７月以来初めて利上げを決定。ＦＯＭＣに合わせて公表された金利・経済見通しでは、年内に少なくともあと１回の利上げが実施される可能性が示唆された。

ＣＭＥフェドウオッチによると、１０月２７─２８日の次回ＦＯＭＣで追加利上げが決定される確率は約５５％。

終盤の取引で、ＦＲＢの金融政策見通しに敏感な２年債利回りは２．５ｂｐ低下の４．７２８％。一時は４．７８７９％と、約２年ぶりの高水準を付けていた。

２年債と１０年債の利回り格差は２１．１ｂｐ。

３０年債利回りは１．５ｂｐ低下の５．２８１％。 

米金融・債券市場：[US/BJ]

＜株式＞　ナスダック総合が連日で終値での最高値を更新した。半導体大手マイクロン・テクノロジーや人工知能（ＡＩ）関連銘柄に買いが入り、ナスダック指数を押し上げた。また、原油価格が１バレル＝１００ドル近辺で推移する中、Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種８月１３日に付けた過去最高値に迫った。

マイクロンは５％高、サンディスクは約７％高となった。

メタ・プラットフォームズが投入したＡＩアシスタント「ミューズ」の成功が、このところＡＩ関連半導体株への買いを後押ししている。

一方、ミューズが小売業者やオンライン証券会社など消費者向け企業と競合するとの懸念から、消費者向けソフトウエア株などに売りが広がった。

配車アプリ大手ウーバー・テクノロジーズとリフトはともに１％超下落。チャールズ・シュワブは６．１％安、民泊仲介大手エアビーアンドビーは３％安となった

原油先物は下落。トランプ米大統領が２２日の国連総会一般討論演説で、イランとの戦闘終結に向けた合意に至らなければ同国を「壊滅させる」可能性があると警告したことが材料視された。

市場では、２４日に予定されている米中首脳会談に注目が集まっている。

Ｓ＆Ｐ主要１１セクターのうち６セクターが下落。ＪＰモルガン・チェースとウェルズ・ファーゴがともに３％超下落する中、金融は１．６８％安となった。通信サービスも０．８％下落した。

Ｓ＆Ｐ５００種指数では、値上がり銘柄数と値下がり銘柄数はほぼ拮抗した。

米取引所の合算出来高は１７９億株と、直近２０営業日の平均である１６３億株を上回った。 

米国株式市場：[.NJP]

＜金先物＞　米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の追加利上げ観測が意識され、金相場は下落。米東部時間午後１時４０分（日本時間２３日午前２時４０分）時点で、金現物は０．２％安の１オンス＝４３３６．２１ドル、米金先物の清算値は０．２％安の４３７６．４０ドルだった。トレーダーの間では１２月の利上げ確率が９０％と見込まれている。セントルイス連銀のムサレム総裁やシカゴ連銀のグールズビー総裁は、旺盛な需要とエネルギー価格上昇に起因するインフレを抑えるため、さらなる利上げの必要性を示唆した。金価格は１月に付けた過去最高値５５９４．８２ドルから２２％超下落している。高金利環境では金は利回りを生む資産に対して魅力が薄れるため、相場の重しとなっている。

ＮＹ貴金属：[GOL/XJ]

＜米原油先物＞　サウジアラビアが東西パイプラインを再稼働させ、原油供給が拡大したことに加え、ホルムズ海峡を通る船舶の動きが活発化したことを背景に下落した。

北海ブレント先物の１１月限清算値は１．０９ドル（１．０９％）安の１バレル＝９９．２５ドル。

米ＷＴＩ先物の１０月限は２２日に取引最終日を迎え、１．１９ドル（１．２４％）安の９４．９９ドルで取引を終えた。

両指標とも取引時間中に２ドル超下落する場面もあった。

サウジアラビアによる東西パイプラインの操業再開により、西部の紅海沿岸のヤンブー港からの輸出は２２日中に再開する可能性がある。

items.title: US accounting firm Sorren is latest to add affiliated law firm
items.author: Sara Merken
items.creator: Sara Merken
items.summary: A national accounting firm that formed last year through the merger of 13 local firms said on Tuesday that it has expanded into legal services, marking the latest move in the accounting industry to create an affiliated law firm.
items.body:
A national accounting firm that formed last year through the merger of 13 local firms said on Tuesday that it has expanded into legal services, marking the latest move in the accounting industry to create an affiliated law firm.
Private equity-backed Sorren said that lawyers at Sorren Law will handle transactional, succession planning, asset protection, estate planning and other legal work for businesses, investors and individuals. Sorren Law is a rebranded version of Mansfield & Mayo, a small law firm based in Nevada and Idaho.
Big Four accounting firm KPMG [USN:L2N3PI15B TEXT:"launched"] a subsidiary law firm, KPMG Law US, in February 2025 after gaining approval from the top court in Arizona, where a program allows people who aren’t lawyers to have an economic interest in law firms. Accounting and advisory firm Aprio also launched a subsidiary law firm last year, Aprio Legal, under the Arizona program.
The Sorren firm has a different setup. Sorren Law is owned by lawyers, not by Meridian, Idaho-based accounting and advisory firm Sorren. The accounting firm and the lawyers are co-invested in Sorren Legal Support, a management services organization that is a subsidiary of Sorren Inc, said Sorren Inc CEO Josh Tyree. The MSO provides administration and other back-end support services to the law firm, which will benefit from Sorren's investments in technology and other areas, he said.
MSOs, used by the healthcare and accounting sectors for years, have generated interest in the legal industry as a way to split up the practice of law and the non-legal services and assets that support a law firm. An MSO can allow outside investment in a firm's business without violating professional ethics rules.
Sorren Law has been hiring lawyers and plans to expand its services into new markets, Tyree said.
Thirteen accounting firms came together last year to form Sorren, which is backed by New York-based private equity firm DFW Capital Partners. DFW did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

items.title: Oil price becoming increasingly important for ECB, Bundesbank chief says
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Oil prices are an increasingly important indicator for ECB policymakers in setting interest rates but other factors also play a crucial role, Bundesbank President Joachim Nagel said on Tuesday after markets raised rate-hike bets on expensive energy.
items.body:
Oil prices are an increasingly important indicator for ECB policymakers in setting interest rates but other factors also play a crucial role, Bundesbank President Joachim Nagel said on Tuesday after markets raised rate-hike bets on expensive energy.
The ECB has already lifted its key rate twice this summer but investors see another three or four moves in the next year as both oil and gas prices are now at its "severe" scenario and inflation could peak at around 4%, twice the bank's target.
ECB President [USN:L1N45A0DM TEXT:"Christine Lagarde"] and Vice President [USN:L8N4591NP TEXT:"Boris Vujcic"] have both pushed back on those bets, arguing that rates do not move in lockstep with oil prices. Their remarks suggested the bank may wait until December to pull the trigger next.
"It's definitely not the only indicator but it's become a more relevant indicator over the last four years, this is for sure," Nagel told an event hosted by London's Society of Professional Economists.
"It is obvious that we in governing council have to look at it and we have to take it into account when we take our decisions," he said about oil prices.
Still, he kept open the door to more rate hikes. He said rates, now at 2.5%, are in a territory that neither restrict economic growth nor stimulate it.
"I cannot exclude that if we are confronted with higher energy prices like this, that we have to go into the mild restrictive territory of monetary policy," he said.
But he played down some worries about second-round inflation effects, arguing that the labour market was far softer than in 2022, when an energy-price-led inflation fuelled increasing wage demands, leading to a wage-price spiral.
He also said there were no significant second-round effects in the data.
For now, the ECB needed to maintain its approach of making decisions meeting by meeting, Nagel said.
This means that policy needs to be somewhere between "constructive ambiguity," or intentional policy vagueness, and setting "forward guidance" or making explicit commitments about future policy moves, Nagel said.

[ロンドン　２２日　ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）理事会メンバーのナーゲル独連銀総裁は２２日、エネルギー価格の高騰でインフレ率が目標を上回って推移していることを受け、ＥＣＢが金融政策を巡る判断を行うに当たり原油価格が一段と重要な指標になっているとの認識を示した。

ナーゲル氏はロンドンで開かれたイベントで、「（政策判断のための）唯一の指標では決してないものの、原油価格の重要性は過去４年間で確実に高まっている」と指摘。「ＥＣＢ理事会が原油価格に注視し、政策決定を行う際に考慮しなければならないのは明らかだ」と語った。

労働市場の動向については、それほど懸念していないと述べた。

items.title: Packers RT Zach Bako-Bewele (knee) out for season
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Green Bay Packers right tackle Zach Bako-Bewele will miss the rest of the season with a torn patellar tendon.
items.body:
Green Bay Packers right tackle Zach Bako-Bewele will miss the rest of the season with a torn patellar tendon.
The 27-year-old veteran, formerly known as Zach Tom, was carted off the field early in Sunday's win over the New York Jets.
Bako-Bewele told reporters Tuesday that he sustained a complete tear of the same tendon he partially tore last season. He is facing another surgery and a lengthy rehabilitation.
Drafted in the fourth round by the Packers in 2022, Bako-Bewele has appeared in 57 career games (53 starts). He signed a four-year, $88 million contract extension in July 2025.
Second-year lineman Anthony Belton is expected to replace Bako-Bewele in the lineup, starting when the Packers (1-1) play their home opener Thursday night against the Atlanta Falcons (0-2).
--Field Level Media

items.title: Soja recua em Chicago enquanto operadores acompanham reunião entre EUA e China
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Os contratos futuros de soja negociados na bolsa de Chicago fecharam em baixa nesta terça-feira, em uma reversão dos fortes ganhos registrados na segunda-feira, enquanto os operadores aguardavam uma cúpula entre os EUA e a China, principal importadora.
items.body:
Os contratos futuros de soja negociados na bolsa de Chicago fecharam em baixa nesta terça-feira, em uma reversão dos fortes ganhos registrados na segunda-feira, enquanto os operadores aguardavam uma cúpula entre os EUA e a China, principal importadora.
Os preços mais baixos do petróleo contribuíram para criar um clima negativo no mercado, segundo os operadores.
A Sinograin, empresa estatal chinesa responsável pelo armazenamento de grãos, anunciou seu segundo leilão em grande escala de soja importada em setembro, poucos dias antes da cúpula em Washington.
Os operadores afirmaram que as vendas tinham como objetivo liberar capacidade de armazenamento para as chegadas previstas de soja dos EUA. Eles esperam que a cúpula entre os líderes nesta semana traga maior clareza sobre a demanda futura da China por soja dos EUA.
Os operadores aguardavam para ver se a China poderia remover o imposto de importação de 10% sobre a soja dos EUA, que tem desestimulado compradores privados chineses a realizar compras.
A soja novembro fechou em baixa de 2,5 centavos, a US$13,255 por bushel. O mercado havia se aproximado anteriormente de uma máxima de quase três anos, registrada em 11 de setembro.
Assim como a soja, o contrato de milho dezembro na CBOT fechou em baixa de 6,25 centavos, cotado a US$5,3675 por bushel.
(Reportagem de Tom Polansek)

items.title: Jets sign QB Will Levis to practice squad
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The New York Jets signed former Tennessee Titans starting quarterback Will Levis to the practice squad on Tuesday.
items.body:
The New York Jets signed former Tennessee Titans starting quarterback Will Levis to the practice squad on Tuesday.
In the corresponding move, the Jets released quarterback Bailey Zappe from the practice squad. Starter Geno Smith and rookie Cade Klubnik are the quarterbacks on New York's active roster.
The Titans released Levis, 27, at the end of the preseason on Aug. 30 and he went unclaimed on waivers.
Levis started 21 games for the Titans after being drafted No. 33 in 2023, completing 61% of his passes for 3,899 yards, 21 touchdowns and 16 interceptions. He had a 5-16 record as a starter and spent last season recovering from right shoulder surgery after being unseated as the starter by 2025 No. 1 overall pick Cam Ward.
Tennessee, which moved up eight spots to draft Levis with the first pick in the second round, signed Mitchell Trubisky to a two-year contract in March and gave the veteran most of the work behind Ward during training camp.
Zappe, 27, has played in 15 games (nine starts) and completed 62.1% of his passes for 2,223 yards, 12 TDs and 14 interceptions.
The New England Patriots selected Zappe in the fourth round of the 2022 NFL Draft.
In other moves, the Jets signed linebacker Troy Reeder to the 53-man active roster and signed linebacker Jaden Keller to the practice squad.
Reeder, 32, was elevated from the practice squad for Sunday's game against the Green Bay Packers and played 25 snaps on special teams. He has played in 107 regular-season games (38 starts) for the Los Angeles Rams (2019-21, 2023-25), Los Angeles Chargers (2022) and Jets.
Keller, 23, an undrafted rookie out of Virginia Tech who signed with New York in May, was released from the practice squad on Sept. 15.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Reports: Giants QB Jaxson Dart (knee) could miss rest of 2026 season
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: New York Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart faces the possibility of season-ending knee surgery as a result of a hit in Monday's loss to the Los Angeles Rams, according to multiple reports.
items.body:
New York Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart faces the possibility of season-ending knee surgery as a result of a hit in Monday's loss to the Los Angeles Rams, according to multiple reports.
Dart was hit on his right side by Rams outside linebacker Byron Young and the force propelled him in the direction of Rams linebacker Josaiah Stewart. Dart went to the ground grabbing for his left knee as medical personnel came to his side, and he left the game during New York's first offensive series.
"Evaluations are ongoing," Giants coach John Harbaugh told reporters Tuesday. "We haven't got any final decisions yet. We've learned a lot more. ..."
Asked if Dart could miss the season, Harbaugh said, "I don't think I could really comment on that right now until we know for sure what's going to transpire."
Initial tests Monday night created optimism Dart, 23, avoided a major knee injury. Harbaugh said after the 28-6 loss to the host Rams that it was "in the neighborhood" of a sprained medial collateral ligament.
But more testing Tuesday -- including an MRI exam -- after the Giants returned to New Jersey detected more significant damage.
"I'm not sure exactly what news or how anything's been stated, but right now I'd say evaluations are ongoing," Harbaugh said. "We haven't got any final decisions yet. We've learned a lot more, I wouldn't really want to share too much until decisions get made. That takes more than one person, takes everybody involved. So, when we know you know what direction we're going to have to go or go or whatever it might be, we'll announce that but we don't have that yet. So, I don't want to get out over our skis on that."
Harbaugh said he won't speculate on the seriousness of Dart's injury.
"That's what you do, but you've got to put yourself in my shoes, that's not my job," Harbaugh said. "I'm not a media person and I just can't do that. It's not the right thing to do, it's when decisions get made and we know which direction we're going to go, then heck yeah, we'll let everybody know what they are. But until that happens, I can't breach those conversations.
"That's trust that you have with people, and I don't even know all the answers because I'm not the person who's hurt. So, I'm not the doctor, either, so I'm privy to it. I kind of know some of it, I don't know all of it and I certainly am not in position to be reporting on it."
Dart was replaced in the game by Jameis Winston, who completed 11 of 27 passes for 111 yards. He also threw an interception.
Dart was the 25th overall pick in the 2025 draft. He's currently 31st in the NFL with 250 passing yards and tied for 14th with three TD passes, all in New York's Week 1 win over the Dallas Cowboys.
New York could contemplate acquiring a quarterback. Current offensive coordinator Matt Nagy has worked closely with current NFL backups Mitchell Trubisky (Titans) and Justin Fields (Chiefs) when he was head coach of the Chicago Bears.
"Absolute faith in all our players," Harbaugh said when asked about Winston. "That's why all the guys are here. Jameis is one of our guys who obviously is here for a reason. He's a very good football player."
The Giants (1-1) host the Tennessee Titans (0-2) on Sunday.
--Field Level Media

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ニューヨーク　２２日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ニューヨーク　２２日　ロイター］ - 米国株式市場では、ナスダック総合が連日で終値での最高値を更新した。半導体大手マイクロン・テクノロジーや人工知能（ＡＩ）関連銘柄に買いが入り、ナスダック指数を押し上げた。また、原油価格が１バレル＝１００ドル近辺で推移する中、Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種８月１３日に付けた過去最高値に迫った。

マイクロンは５％高、サンディスクは約７％高となった。

メタ・プラットフォームズが投入したＡＩアシスタント「ミューズ」の成功が、このところＡＩ関連半導体株への買いを後押ししている。

一方、ミューズが小売業者やオンライン証券会社など消費者向け企業と競合するとの懸念から、消費者向けソフトウエア株などに売りが広がった。

配車アプリ大手ウーバー・テクノロジーズとリフトはともに１％超下落。チャールズ・シュワブは６．１％安、民泊仲介大手エアビーアンドビーは３％安となった

原油先物は下落。トランプ米大統領が２２日の国連総会一般討論演説で、イランとの戦闘終結に向けた合意に至らなければ同国を「壊滅させる」可能性があると警告したことが材料視された。

市場では、２４日に予定されている米中首脳会談に注目が集まっている。

テミス・トレーディングの株式市場構造調査責任者、ジョー・サルッツィ氏は「対立を続けるのではなく、何らかの国際的な枠組みを構築できる可能性について、少なくとも対話を始めることが求められている」と述べた。

Ｓ＆Ｐ主要１１セクターのうち６セクターが下落。ＪＰモルガン・チェースとウェルズ・ファーゴがともに３％超下落する中、金融は１．６８％安となった。通信サービスも０．８％下落した。

Ｓ＆Ｐ５００種指数では、値上がり銘柄数と値下がり銘柄数はほぼ拮抗した。

米取引所の合算出来高は１７９億株と、直近２０営業日の平均である１６３億株を上回った。

COMMODITIES/METALS: [USN:L1N45E004 TEXT:"Oil"] falls for fifth day, longest losing streak since August last year. Average US diesel up to new high $6.5276 a gallon. [USN:L4N45E01B TEXT:"Gold"] slips.

Today's Talking Points:
Gotta get a message to you
After the flurry of major central bank decisions over the last 10 days comes the even bigger flurry of policymaker speeches, interviews, and media appearances. Do market expectations move all that much from where they were the day of these decisions and press conferences by chiefs Warsh, Lagarde, Ueda and Bailey? Not really, because the general consensus views and likely policy paths, such as they exist, have already been laid out.
There are 19 Fed policymakers (although only 12 voters at any one time), and 27 ECB rate-setters - that's a lot of commentary for investors to ignore. The BoE and BOJ's nine-strong policymaking committees are positively lean by comparison. Investors are more likely to take their lead in the coming days from elsewhere - fresh economic data, corporate developments, geopolitics, Middle East energy supply shifts.
Oil slick
Global oil prices are back below $100 a barrel, with Brent and WTI crude futures falling on Tuesday for a fifth straight day. That's the longest downward streak for both benchmarks in over a year. Could the market be at a turning point? Has the second oil shock of the Iran war come and gone? It would probably be unwise to be too confident, but [USN:L8N45E0CI TEXT:"a peace deal in the offing"] and more supply potentially coming back onto the market could have a significant impact.
All that is hypothetical right now. Oil is still up 50% from a year ago, and analysts estimate that up to half of the US inflation overshoot is down to elevated energy and commodity prices. But a sustained decline would wipe much of that away, and call into question the recent strengthening of market rate hike expectations - and policymaker signaling - across much of the developed world.
Disunited Nations
The United Nations General Assembly is in full flow, with nearly 130 world leaders gathered in New York. That's not a great turnout, which may reflect the old world order of multilateralism, globalization and cross-border cooperation gradually giving way to one characterized more by nationalism, bilateral agreements and de-globalization. The biggest 'no-show' is Chinese President Xi Jinping, who will meet Trump in Washington later this week.
Trump addressed the UN assembly today (prompting a walkout by the Cuban delegation), and UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres gave his final address, in which he called for greater curbs on AI. One wonders how many world leaders will be showing up at the annual jamboree in 5 or 10 years' time (presuming AI hasn't wiped out mankind by then).
What could move markets tomorrow?
Global PMIs (September, flash estimates)
Indonesia interest rate decision
European Central Bank officials scheduled to speak include chief economist Philip Lane and board member Piero Cipollone
US Treasury sells $70 billion of 5-year notes at auction

items.title: Cacau se recupera de mínimas de várias semanas; açúcar bruto também avança
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Os contratos futuros do cacau se recuperaram nesta terça-feira, após atingirem mínimas de sete semanas e meia no início do pregão, enquanto o açúcar bruto também voltou a subir, depois de cair para uma mínima de 4 semanas.
items.body:
Os contratos futuros do cacau se recuperaram nesta terça-feira, após atingirem mínimas de sete semanas e meia no início do pregão, enquanto o açúcar bruto também voltou a subir, depois de cair para uma mínima de 4 semanas.
CACAU * O cacau de Londres fechou com alta de £37, ou 0,9%, a £3.998 por tonelada métrica. O mercado havia registrado, anteriormente, uma mínima de 7 semanas e meia, de £3.799.
* Os corretores afirmaram que a recente fraqueza foi impulsionada pelo excesso de oferta, embora se espere um mercado mais equilibrado na safra de 2026/27, com a produção global prevista para cair.
* A precipitação ficou abaixo da média na semana passada na maioria das principais regiões produtoras de cacau da Costa do Marfim, e os agricultores afirmaram na segunda-feira que as condições de seca poderiam ameaçar o desenvolvimento das pequenas vagens que devem ser colhidas no próximo ano, durante a safra principal, que vai de setembro a fevereiro.
* O contrato futuro de cacau de Nova York subiu 1%, para US$5.402 por tonelada, após atingir uma mínima de 7 semanas e meia, de US$ 5.111.
AÇÚCAR * O açúcar bruto fechou com alta de 0,11 centavo, ou 0,6%, a 17,59 centavos por libra-peso, após atingir uma mínima de 4 semanas de 17,11 centavos.
* Operadores afirmaram que a retração do mercado em relação à máxima de 16 meses de 18,88 centavos, registrada em 10 de setembro, ainda pode se aprofundar, embora as perspectivas sejam mais positivas no médio a longo prazo, com o fenômeno climático El Niño previsto para prejudicar a produção e, potencialmente, levar a um déficit global na safra de 2026/27.
* O preço do açúcar branco permaneceu praticamente inalterado em US$507,90 por tonelada, após atingir uma mínima de US$496,80, a menor cotação em 6 semanas e meia.
CAFÉ * O café arábica fechou em queda de 4,1 centavos, ou 1,5%, a US$2,723 por libra-peso, após atingir uma mínima de três meses de US$ 2,7130.
* Os corretores afirmaram que as condições climáticas favoráveis à safra nos principais países produtores, Brasil e Vietnã, contribuíram para a recente desvalorização.
* Eles observaram, no entanto, que a atividade no mercado físico no Brasil começou a ser afetada, já que os produtores se abstiveram de vender mais grãos aos preços atuais.
* O café robusta recuou 2,3%, para US$3.260 a tonelada. O mercado havia atingido, anteriormente, uma mínima de mais de três meses, de US$ 3.245.
(Reportagem de Nigel Hunt e Marcelo Teixeira)

[ワシントン ２２日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領が７月、実業家イーロン・マスク氏率いる宇宙開発企業スペースＸの株式を最大５万ドル相当購入し、その後一部を売却していたことが、公開された財務開示報告書で明らかになった。

トランプ氏が９月８日に署名した財務開示報告書によると、７月１０日に１万５００１─５万ドル相当のスペースＸ株を購入し、同月１７日に１００１─１万５０００ドル相当を売却した。

今回の取引により、政権が同社の事業に影響を及ぼし得る判断を行う中、トランプ大統領とスペースＸとの間に新たな金銭的つながりが生じたことになる。

スペースＸは米軍の主要請負業者で、事業運営に関して連邦政府機関の承認や認可を頻繁に必要としている。

スペースＸは６月１２日にナスダック市場に上場。初日の終値は新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）価格の１３５ドルを約１９％上回り、時価総額は約２兆１０００億ドルに達した。これにより、マスク氏は史上初の「トリリオネア（１兆ドル長者）」となった。
